_comment: System Settings privacy panes, the one table every privacy-pane URL is built from (adapters/privacy_settings.lua). A pane URL is a form prefix followed by the pane anchor. macOS 26 refused the legacy com.apple.preference.security form for Screen Recording (ledger L29), so from extension_from_major on the PrivacySecurity extension form is used. tools/dev/collect-macos-field-report.sh opens every form of every pane on the Mac and records each exit code, which proves the choice.
